facts: Broadcom reported fiscal Q4 2025 on December 11, 2025; the quarter ended November 2, 2025.
Fiscal Q4 revenue was USD 18.015 billion, up 28% year over year; adjusted EBITDA was USD 12.218 billion, 68% of revenue.
Operating cash flow was USD 7.703 billion, capital expenditure USD 0.237 billion, and free cash flow USD 7.466 billion.
Company guidance for fiscal Q1 2026 was revenue approximately USD 19.1 billion and adjusted EBITDA 67% of projected revenue; these were forecasts, not actual Q1 results.
The CEO expected fiscal Q1 2026 AI semiconductor revenue around USD 8.2 billion, driven by custom AI accelerators and Ethernet AI switches.
note: Retrospective reconstruction from the previous official release only; not a contemporaneous forecast.
